$schema_note: C-authored, independent of B runner code. Values are derived only from SSOTV3 04_FLOW_CODEBOOK §2-§5, 03_COLLECTION_MEASUREMENT_SPEC §5-§9, 00_SSOT §6-§7, 02_DATA_SCHEMA §4-§5 and from the fixture geometry C built.

derivation_rules_preregistered.task_flow_sequence: experienced_flow_sequence with every DISMISS_OBSTRUCTION removed; order preserved; terminal token (ENDPOINT_REACHED|AUTH_GATE) kept as last element (codebook §3 example keeps AUTH_GATE).
derivation_rules_preregistered.activation_depth: count of tokens in ACTIVATION_SET. SUBMIT_QUERY IS counted (it is a button activation; 03 §6 exclusion list names only scroll, passive load, per-character typing, popup dismiss). INPUT_QUERY, DISMISS_OBSTRUCTION, AUTH_GATE, ENDPOINT_REACHED are not.
derivation_rules_preregistered.flow_step_count: count of task_flow_sequence tokens excluding the pure terminal markers ENDPOINT_REACHED/ABSTAIN; AUTH_GATE IS counted because 04 §4 says 'auth encounter 포함'. Typing/submit counted. Scroll/dismiss never counted.
derivation_rules_preregistered.menu_dependency: true iff any REVEAL_SET token precedes the terminal token. SWITCH_TAB is left undecided (not exercised by these fixtures) and must be pre-registered before use.
derivation_rules_preregistered.nav_container_depth: count of REVEAL_SET tokens that precede SELECT_FUNCTION. SELECT_CATEGORY that navigates to a category page is a page transition, not a container reveal, so it does not add depth (fixture 1: depth 1, not 2).
derivation_rules_preregistered.forced_dismissal_count: count of DISMISS_OBSTRUCTION in experienced_flow_sequence; each must be paired with a fact_task_obstruction row with dismiss_required_for_task=true.
derivation_rules_preregistered.dismiss_required_for_task: true iff the next frozen-path control is not hittable (hit-test at its center lands on the interrupt) until an allowed close control is activated. Geometric overlap alone is insufficient; a blocking_proof click must fail.
derivation_rules_preregistered.task_control_occlusion: fraction of a uniform 9x9 sample grid inside the next-path-control bbox whose elementFromPoint is neither the control nor its descendant (hit-test); cross-checked with bbox-intersection against [data-c-overlay] elements. Measured against the path-entry control of the CURRENT state (hamburger at S0 when the task function is behind a menu).
derivation_rules_preregistered.overlay_coverage: secondary only: overlay bbox area / viewport area. Non-zero coverage with occlusion 0 is NOT an obstruction (fixture 3).
derivation_rules_preregistered.s0_task_control_visible: true iff the SELECT_FUNCTION control's bbox intersects the S0 viewport and it is hittable. A hamburger that leads to it does not count.
derivation_rules_preregistered.first_visible_scroll_state: first scroll-only state Sk (scroll step chosen by runner within [120,844] px) whose viewport intersects the SELECT_FUNCTION control; 'NONE' when no scroll state exposes it (menu-hidden or login wall).

auth_gate_stage.BEFORE_TASK_DISCOVERY: AUTH_GATE with no SELECT_FUNCTION before it: no task-specific control observable at any scroll state S0..Sn and no reveal container available without auth.
auth_gate_stage.AFTER_TASK_SELECT: AUTH_GATE occurs at/after SELECT_FUNCTION and before any result-level token (SELECT_RESULT/OPEN_ITEM_DETAIL/OPEN_PLACE_DETAIL) and before any task results surface is rendered. Position rule wins even if the gated action would have yielded the endpoint (e.g. F3 where the form itself is the endpoint).
auth_gate_stage.AT_ENDPOINT: AUTH_GATE occurs on a result-level activation after a task results surface was rendered without auth, OR the endpoint surface is rendered but the contract-required content (e.g. F5 time+price) is withheld behind auth.

derivation_rules_preregistered.endpoint_status: REACHED iff the family endpoint contract is satisfied in the final state; AUTH_GATE iff final token is AUTH_GATE; nothing else exercised here.
derivation_rules_preregistered.generic_login_rule: presence of a login control/link anywhere on the page never produces AUTH_GATE; only a gate that the frozen task path enters counts (00 §6, 03 §7). Fixture 4 is the negative control.
derivation_rules_preregistered.lossless: runner's fact_flow_step rows, ordered by step_index, restricted to token-bearing rows, must equal lossless_check as (state_before,data-c-action,state_after) triples with state = body[data-c-state]; url_before/url_after must differ exactly where the fixture changes location.hash (every recorded step).
